visual_review: Composition is closely preserved: maple upper-left, warm bento shop right, lane vanishing left-center, blue-hour rain palette. Wet stone patterns and highlights, maple silhouettes, roof tile ridges and timber grain differ. Slightly crisper/higher-contrast texture; no obvious framing shift. Native output is only 1672x941, below required 2560px width, so this is not an acceptable high-resolution master.
